programme.title: South Park: Den magiske busken
programme.desc: Cartman og Butters får tak på en drone og tar en flytur i nabolaget.

programme.title: South Park: Å, jøsses
programme.desc: Gerald står ansikt til ansikt med Trolljegeren.

programme.title: South Park: Du yelper ikke til
programme.desc: Cartman ser seg som den beste restaurantkritikeren på nettet i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Sparkesyklene
programme.desc: Ungene planlegger å bruke siste nytt innen forflytning for å skaffe seg mer godteri til halloween enn de har fått noen gang.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans teite hatkriminalitet 2000
programme.desc: FBI etterforsker Cartman for hatkriminalitet etter at han har kastet en stein på Token.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bok som blir valgt ut til Oprahs bokklubb og blir en bestselger blant folk som vil overvinne avhengighet.

programme.title: South Park: Taperne
programme.desc: Guttene er lei av å spille baseball og legger en plan for å tape en viktig kamp. Randy trener hardt for å bli den største fulle idioten på hver kamp.

programme.title: South Park: Franchiseplaner
programme.desc: Facebook er det ultimate våpenet for professor Chaos.

programme.title: South Park: Vektøkning 4 000
programme.desc: Cartman vinner en skolekonkurranse ved å jukse. Mr. Garrison planlegger å drepe Kathy Lee Gifford, som skal dele ut prisen

programme.title: South Park: Dum, bortskjemt hore-leketøy
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åpner butikk i South Park og forderver jentenes moral - bare Wendy holder fast på sine prinsipper.

programme.title: South Park: Bank beveren min
programme.desc: Ike kommer i puberteten, og han og Kyle glir fra hverandre. For at de skal bli bedre venner igjen, tar Kyle med Ike for å se 'Yo Gabba Gabba' live.

programme.title: South Park: Den meksikanske jokeren
programme.desc: Randy slåss mot hjemmedyrking. Imens drar Kyle på leir.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog sjmegnskog
programme.desc: Guttene sendes til regnskogen i Costa Rica med et kor.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, blir invitert til showet som enslig studiopuplikum. Mandy viser seg å være mer av en forfølger enn et fan, og de blir nødt til å kvitte seg med henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyllinger på rømmen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam starter med å klekke ut kyllinger for et naturfagprosjekt. Kyllingene klekkes tidligere enn ventet og rømmer fra inkubatoren. Nå må Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer finne alle kyllingene rundt om i leiligheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil ikke krangle
programme.desc: Carly makes Sam en unik iCarly T-skjorte for å markere årsdagen for vennskapet deres. Men når Sam bytter den bort mot konsertbiletter, havner de to vennene i klammeri.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansende drømmer
programme.desc: iCarly ber fansen om å sende inn videoer av dem selv når de danser sine kuleste danser. Over tre tusen danseklipp kommer inn, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver å holde seg oppe hele natten for å se på alle videoene.

programme.title: iCarly: Det spøker på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en leilighet som det sies at det spøker i. Når det begynner å skje nifse ting, begynner også vennene å bli redde for at spøkelsesryktene er sanne.

programme.title: iCarly: En dag jeg vil angre
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet til hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til å gå med på å delta i iCarly. Merkelige ting begynner å gå feil midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies nettvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjensittingen
programme.desc: Sam må sitte igjen den kvelden iCarly holder sin 50. nettvideospesialsending. Carly og Freddie kan da altså ikke gjøre som de pleier, så de prøver så godt de kan å få gjennsitting de også, så de kan sende fra skolebenken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie blir invitert til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de blir tilbudt en stor pengesum får å gå god for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foten, på iCarly. Men det viser seg at skoene er forferdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs help a 1988 Acura Legend live up to its name.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: When Xzibit rolls on into the garage with the Fairlane, the boys can't believe their eyes. So they decide to give West his Fairlane back to tinker with and get him a brand-new pimped Toyota 4Runner.

programme.title: Punk'd: Dave Navarro, Carmen Electra, Tara Reid
programme.desc: Carmen Elektra and Dave Navarro are picked up by a limo driver who loves to hit and run, Tara Reid feels the same wrath as Carmen and Dave, with the same outcome and Ordinary people are hired to fill the seats at the funeral of an extraordinary soul.

programme.title: Punk'd: Mekhi Phiffer, Brandy, Linkin Park
programme.desc: Mike Shinoda (Linkin Park) is the victim of an illegally parked fire hydrant next to his car, Brandy's got her brother's back when the Punk'd police investigate stolen jewelry and Mekhi Phifer finds himself in the hot seat for an unpaid ticket.

programme.title: Punk'd: Jena Malone, Shannon Elizabeth, Carmelo Anthony
programme.desc: Jena Malone is given the wrong car from a velt and is blamed for missing cash upon return, Shannon Elizabeth is told she's the star of a sex tape and Carmelo Anthony returns to his hotel room and is blamed for hosting an under-aged rockstar bash.

programme.title: Punk'd: Good Charlotte, Kanye West, Tyra Banks
programme.desc: Tyra Banks and her family get caught in the middle of a "Girls Gone Crazy" Shoot, Kayne West experiences a video shoot shutdown, all brought on by the Punk'd Film Commission and Joel Madden's (Good Charlotte) towed car drops in on another.

programme.title: Punk'd: Penelope Cruz, Salma Hayek, Jesse Metcalfe, Eva Longoria, Mario
programme.desc: Things get messy when Penelope Cruz gives Salma Hayek a lesson in potty training. Things get desperate for Eva Longoria when she is stopped by the cops.

programme.title: Punk'd: Zoe Saldana, Serena Williams, Donald Faison, Zack Braff
programme.desc: Ashton Aces Serena Williams with a car chase. Zach Braff gets scrubbed by co-star Donald Faison when his precious Porsche gets Punk'd.

programme.title: Punk'd: Jadakiss, Rachel Bilson, Dirk Nowitzki
programme.desc: Summer gets schooled when Rachel Bilson gets a wet and wild punk. Jadakiss jams to traffic when he gets Punk'd in the car.

programme.title: Punk'd: Omarion, Marques Houston, Andy Roddick, Jamie-Lynn Discala
programme.desc: Ashton lobs an overhead smash to Andy Roddick when he gets stuck on the way to the Tonight Show. Soprano's Jamie Lynn-Discala gives a bad tip and gets a waitress fired.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob og Steelo besøk av Nina Agdal og møter farer på nært hold i 'Åttebeinsskrekk', tilbringer tid i 'Det farligste rommet' og drar til byggeplasser og pådrar seg 'Byggeskader'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal II
programme.desc: I en splitter ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob og Steelo besøk av Nina Agdal og møter noen sultne barn som er 'Sniksnacksere', møter kjæledyr som nekter eierne å være alene på badet i 'Baderomsdegger' og drikker rom med 'Partypirater'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal III
programme.desc: I en helt ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob og Steelo besøk av gjestevert Nina Agdal og ser på effekten av 'Hoppunktering', sjekker alternative bruksområder for gamle esker i 'Full papp' før de oppdager noen lumske puser i 'Kattetyver'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal IV
programme.desc: I en splitter ny episode av 'Ridiculousness' hjelper Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal folk å komme over sine 'Overlevelsessjokk', mister tålmodigheten til GPS-en i 'Navigasjonsirritasjon' og går ut i gatene og får svar i 'Tilfeldige undersøkelser'.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: My Birthday Romance
programme.desc: Callie Fitzgerald is tired of her family fixing her up and questioning her single status. She is determined to find a pretend boyfriend for her 35th birthday party just so her family will leave her alone. What she didn’t expect was to actually fall for him.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. With a little nudging from the matchmaking daughter, Sophie and Michael unexpectedly start to fall in love and Sophie must decide between returning home or following her heart.

programme.title: A Country Romance
programme.desc: When Sarah Kress learns her family’s vineyard is up for sale, she leaves her busy urban life and visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of handsome neighbor Gabe, huge challenge becomes fun as she and Gabe fall in love. But when the job is done, Sarah must decide whether to return to her fast-paced life or follow her heart.

programme.title: The Florida Project
programme.desc: Seks år gamle Moonee og hennes mor som bor på et budsjettmotell utenfor Disney World i Florida.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert føler seg innesperret, i en kjedelig amerikansk småby, med ansvar for sin autistiske lillebror og bevegelseshemmete mor. Men en dag kommer Becky til byen, og snart oppstår det et skjørt og spesielt vennskap dem imellom.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: Den kompromissløse og forførende kunstneren Ingrid forgifter kjæresten sin i et anfall av sykelig sjalusi. Hun idømmes livsvarig fengsel og hennes 15-årige datter Astrid blir deretter kastet rundt mellom ulike fosterhjem.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun trives som en smart, men ufokusert surfer, helt til han oppdager en roman av den anerkjente forfatteren Martin Skinner. Han blir inspirert, og forlater Orange County for å studere kreativ skriving ved Stanford University.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Michael, en talentfull gambler med syv dager til å betale et stort beløp til et grådig kasino eller miste livet, samler et lag av mennesker med overnaturlige evner for å vinne stort på et kasino. Men han finner en mye sterkere rival og oppdager at kreftene til vennene hans rommer en helt ny verden.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Marvels farligste dame, Elektra, blir brakt tilbake til livet etter å ha fått livstruende skader i ”Daredevil”. Men hennes nyeste oppdrag som leiemorder tvinge henne til å ta et skjebnesvangert valg. Med Jennifer Garner.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: FBI-agenten Malcolm Turner må igjen spille Big Momma, enrappkjeftet bestemor fra sørstatene med frekkhet så detholder!

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Et mordmysterium satt i en verden hvor mennesker og dukker eksisterer sammen, men dukkene blir sett på som annenrangs borgere. Når dukkene fra en 80-talls barne-tv serie blir drept en etter en, tar en tidligere politimann, som siden har blitt privatetterforsker, på seg saken.

programme.title: Umeå 4Ever
programme.desc: Stian er 31 år gammel, har lenge slitt med kjærligheten, og etter hvert har han senket kravene sine så mye at han nesten tar til takke med den som vil ha ham.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Marcel jobber som skopusser i havnebyen Le Havre. En dag endrer alt seg når en ung flyktning trenger hans hjelp. Aki Kaurismäkis Le Havre er en hyllest til franske filmer fra en svunnen tid, men også et håpefullt og aktuelt humanistisk verk.

programme.title: Triple Dare
programme.desc: Rebekka, Claudia og Sofie går i 1. videregående. Selv om de er konfirmert, merker de daglig at de befinner seg et sted mellom barn og voksen.

programme.title: Lev Sterkt
programme.desc: I "Lev Sterkt" får kombinasjonen av gaterace og alkohol fatale konsekvenser da Nikolaj og hans beste venn Martin med gassen i bunn dreper ei unge jente. Martin havner i fengsel, og Nikolaj går fri.

programme.title: Amatører
programme.desc: Det lille stedet Lafors prøver å lokke til seg den tyske lavpriskjeden Superbilly, noe som vil skape mange etterlengtede arbeidsplasser. Kommunen utlyser en videokonkurranse og venninnene Dana og Aida går i gang med pågangsmot, smarttelefon og selfiestang.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En urolig indianerveteran danner et ekstraordinært vennskap med sin franske psykoanalytiker, mens de prøver å finne en kur mot lidelsene hans.

En ung forfatter tvinges til å godta at han er dødelig når han oppdager at han har en sjelden kreftform. Med hjelp av bestevennen og en omsorgsfull ung psykolog; finner han motet til å kjempe imot sykdommen.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Hitler styrker sitt grep om Vest-Europa, og etter hvert blir Kanaløyene også okkupert. Tyskerne anlegger en base der hvor krigsfanger blir satt til slavearbeid i arbeidsleire. Innbyggerne i Jersey går en usikker fremtid i møte.

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Stet, en urolig og sint 11 år gammel foreldreløs fra en liten by i Texas, ender opp på en guttekorskole i øst etter at alenemoren hans dør.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: Den Oscarnominerte regissøren Todd Haynes er tilbake med ny film! I'M NOT THERE er en ukonvensjonell reise gjennom Bob Dylans liv og musikk. Filmen beskriver Dylans mange sider og identiteter.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: ”Peace, Love & Misunderstanding” er et hjertevarmt portrett av en fargerik familie. Filmen forteller historien om Diane, en småsær New York City advokat som har et desperat behov for å flykte etter ektemannen ber om skilsmisse.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai er en sjarmerende kunstkjenner og livsnyter med dyre vaner. Han går med på å hjelpe den britiske etterretningstjenesten MI5 med å finne et stjålet maleri, som sies å gjemme på koden til en svimlende sum gjemte nazi-millioner...

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: I årevis har byfolk vært livredde for eneboeren Felix Bush. Folk sier han driver med alle slags unevnelige ting - at han har drept med kaldt blod, at han står i ledtog med djevelen, at han har merkelige krefter - og de unngår ham som pesten.

programme.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
programme.desc: Dette er en romantisk komedie om alle historiene til mennesker som jobber med et bryllup for å gi et elskende par den helt perfekte dagen.

programme.title: Månedens ansatt (Employee of the Month)
programme.desc: To konkurranselystne ansatte på Super Club kjemper om tittelen "Månedens ansatt" og om å vinne hjertet til den sexy nye kassadama i denne hysteriske komedien.

programme.title: Kringkaster jul
programme.desc: Når hennes on-air partner bestemmer seg for å forlate USAs favoritt morgenshow, kunngjør Veronika Daniels at hun vil velge sin nye medvert fra en håndfull kandidater som inkluderer Charlie Fisher, en lokal nyhetsoppleser i NY.

programme.title: Beautiful Creatures
programme.desc: 17 år gamle Ethan drømmer seg langt vekk fra den lille hjembyen sin - inntil han treffer Lena som nettopp har flyttet dit

programme.title: That Awkward Moment
programme.desc: Hva er bedre enn å være single i New York? Zac Efron, Miles Teller og Michael B. Jordan har en pakt om å unngå parforhold for en hver pris, men når de alle sammen begynner å date i smug begynner også en umulig kamp for ikke å bli oppdaget av de andre.

programme.title: Alvemannen
programme.desc: En alv blir etterlatt av julenissen for å redde Harper-familien fra en elendig jul. Alven og familien får mer enn de regnet med. Barna hjelper alven med å oppdage kreftene hans- og hans sanne identitet som en kommende superhelt.

programme.title: Mitt Julemotell
programme.desc: Når foretningskvinne Jennifer blir informert om at foreledrene hennes er bortreist i juleferien uten henne, bestemmer hun seg for å reise vekk fra det travsomme bylivet i San Francisco for å besøke hennes bestemors motel i Alaska som ble etterlatt til henne for renovasjon og salg.

programme.title: Nothing Like the Holidays
programme.desc: De fjerntliggende medlemmene av Rodriguez-familien samles hjemme hos foreldrene for å møte det som kan bli deres siste jul sammen i denne hjertevarmende feriekomedien.

programme.title: Nøkkelen til Jul
programme.desc: Når en misfornøyd alv tar over Nordpolen, snur hun tiden bakover og julenissen blir yngre… fort! Det er opp til en lojal alv, en liten jente med en magisk nøkkel og den nå tenåringsnissen å redde fremtiden til julen.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: Basert på boken fra den bestselgende krimforfatteren Mary Higgins Clark kommer denne julens krimgåte. En kvinnelig detektiv slår seg sammen med en amatøretterforsker for å finne sin savnede far.

programme.title: Christmas at the Greenbrier
programme.desc: A retired pro athlete reunites with his former flame at a luxury resort, rekindling their holiday romance.

programme.title: Golden Christmas
programme.desc: A special dog reunites childhood sweethearts as they battle over buying the same house for Christmas.

programme.title: Seeking a friend at the end of the world
programme.desc: Asteroiden ”Mathilda” er på kollisjonskurs med jorden og er varslet å treffe innen de neste 3 ukene. Forsikringsagenten Dodge Peterson hadde en kone som flyktet i panikk, så for å korte ned ventetiden, bestemmer han seg for å sette seg i bilen for å treffe igjen sin ungdomsforelskelse fra skoledagene.

programme.title: Christmas at the Greenbrier
programme.desc: A retired pro athlete reunites with his former flame at a luxury resort, rekindling their holiday romance.

programme.title: Golden Christmas
programme.desc: A special dog reunites childhood sweethearts as they battle over buying the same house for Christmas.

programme.title: No Good Deed
programme.desc: Jack Friar (Samuel L. Jackson) er en erfaren politimann som vanligvis oppfatter farene på mils avstand. Men denne gang svikter intuisjonen hans da han intetanende havner midt i et banktyveri og blir tatt som gissel. Mens banden høylydt krangler om Jacks skjebne, bevoktes han av lederen Tyrones vakre kjæreste, Erin (Milla Jovovich). De to etterlates alene. Erin vet hvordan hun skal manipulere menn og snart begynner hun et spill der Jack er brikken…

programme.title: Fire With Fire
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt vitne til det brutale mordet på en kioskeier og hans sønn, klarer brannmannen Jeremy Coleman (Duhamel) så vidt å flykte med livet i behold. Som et sentralt øyenvitne må han nå vitne i rettsaken til en høytstående kriminell, og blir deretter plassert i et vitnebeskyttelsesprogram ledet av en U.S. Marshal. Men da hans nye identitet blir røpet, blir det brennhet rundt Jeremy og han står ovenfor de mest nervepirrende timene i sitt liv.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Mestertyven Will Montgomery (Nicolas Cage) blir løslatt etter å ha sittet fengslet i 10 år for et spektakulært innbrudd med et ransutbytte på $ 10 millioner. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. programme.title: When good intentions backfire SPECTACULARLY
programme.desc: After their recent break away from the kids to ‘disconnect and reconnect’ Abbey and Pete are back with tales of when even the best of intentions can backfire with hilarious results. Thailand in the depths of monsoon season? Sounds like the perfect opportunity for Abbey to tear through three books and avoid talking to Pete at all costs… In our weekly whine (or shine) club, we hear from a couple who have had the picture perfect proposal in nowhere else than the big apple itself as well as a woman who is convinced her husband has taken up whistling as a full time hobby just to drive her round the bend. And we also hear some outrageous chat which will hopefully stand as a warning to all you guys on why you shouldn’t drunk and dial. On this week’s Therapy Crouch we’ve got 99 problems but a b*tch aint one. Enjoy!

programme.title: Wedding Planning
programme.desc: On today’s episode, we get an exclusive invite to the planning behind the wedding of the decade. From pre-match nerves to Elton John’s florist - learn more about the planning of the most important day of Abbey’s life (and probably Pete’s as well). We also hear how Abbey feels how she has made a load of new friends since starting the podcast and why Peter is still struggling to show his face in the bakery after THAT famous incident. And your favourite Agony Ab is back, helping to navigate the tricky waters of what to do when your girlfriend plans, and pays for, your wedding without your knowledge but on your credit card and how to get out of your sister’s OTT wedding prep.

programme.title: To Dream The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: In this week’s Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter take a while to sit down and discuss some of their dreams and aspirations both as a pair of youngsters and now as one of the UK’s most prominent power couples. We hear about Abbey’s early days in Genie Queen - Liverpool’s answer to the Sugababes - and a young football protege with dreams of scoring 100 premier league goals and becoming the nation’s Podfather in the process. We also hear from our lovely listeners with their Weekly Whines and Agony Abs. We hear about one of listeners whose girlfriend has being using their toothbrush for bit of DIY and a fellow NETTO alumni has been in touch with a playground anthem that has been sung for generations across Merseyside. Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Therapy Crouch! On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch’s Christmas Party!!!
programme.desc: It is a double celebration in the Crouch household after Scott pulled his finger out and asked the big Q - which has prompted some discussions on Abbey trading hers in for an upgrade (ring not fella) Although it isn’t all festive cheer as the pair have been up to their usual antics and have come locked and loaded with multiple weekly whines - a lot of of them regarding the other’s fashion faux pas. And fear not, we are not abandoning you guys with your own relationship woes, Agony Ab is still on the couch to help with your long distance heart ache and those of you who are struggling with husbands who have little to no interest in putting the Christmas tree up!! Bah humbug! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - Will You Marry Me?
programme.desc: This week, Abbey and Peter provide a schooling session on how to nail the perfect proposal (spoiler: It does not involve chemtrails) Weekly Whine club is also back, with Abbey and Peter going a bit more upmarket to celebrate the roaring success that is The Therapy Crouch! We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Gen Z Watch Little Britain, Fat Families & Jeremy Kyle For The First Time
programme.desc: Gen Z watches Little Britain, Fat Families, and The Jeremy Kyle Show for the first time and gives their honest reactions to some of the most unhinged British television ever made. From outrageous sketches to brutal reality TV moments, they explore whether it was funny, uncomfortable, or both.

programme.title: Chris Pratt Takes On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Pratt takes on the ultimate British test as he attempts some of the UK's most iconic accents. From London to the North, see how well he really knows British voices and culture.

programme.title: Chris O’Dowd Plays Time Capsule
programme.desc: Chris O'Dowd becomes the first guest to take on the brand new Time Capsule format, building a personal capsule with items connected to his life, career, childhood and biggest memories. He discusses Bridesmaids sequel talk and possible MCU ambitions, the Dublin versus London debate, and shares stories and nostalgic moments throughout.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Average Joe
programme.desc: Average Joe speaks with workers from the Galway Rape Crisis Centre about their free services. They discuss the importance of listening and believing survivors of sexual violence, the role of art therapy in supporting trauma processing, and why you don't need the right words or a label to reach out for help. t.

programme.title: Will Arnett & John Bishop Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Hollywood star Will Arnett and British comedian John Bishop take on the ultimate British Test. From debating if British people are polite to sampling classic British food, tea etiquette, and slang — this duo delivers laughs, charm, and plenty of friendly rivalry. Who's the real British expert? Watch Will Arnett and John Bishop take on the challenge and find out.

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians - Hélène Landemore Interview
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Who Broke Britain's Energy System?
programme.desc: Arthur Downing, an energy expert, discusses his book Power and the People, which charts the history of British energy and how the system became broken.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the “sub-second” reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 “Little Bird” helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at “the sharp end of the spear.” A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - eldon episode 229
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Nerd Connection episode 230
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university’s rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Touched episode 231
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MONNI episode 232
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dropping Like Flies
programme.desc: Deltakerne sliter med å venne seg til livet uten Vinny, mens Mike konfronterer sine indre demoner. Men det er også Paulys bursdag, og han får sitt livs beste gave!

programme.desc: Mike kommer tilbake, bare for å finne ut at Danny har truet med å finne nye medboere! Jentene leier strippere til Pauly og Mikes ville bursdagsfest, og deltakerne reiser til Staten Island for å kidnappe Vinny. Men vil han bli med dem?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Nothing But Nice
programme.desc: Vinny kommer tilbake, og alle feirer. Mike prøver å være hyggelig, men ender opp med å irritere guttene. Snooki sliter med en ubehagelig situasjon.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Follow Game

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Love at the Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Alle deltakerne er konsentrert om sine nåværende kjærester, men det er aldri fred og ro i huset. En av deltakerne skaper drama for The Meatballs, mens Jennis utfordrende klær skaper problemer for Roger.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sharp Objects
programme.desc: Deltakerne prøver å unngå et haiangrep på fisketur. Jenni konfronterer Paulys stalker. Snooki ser seg ut Vinny da hun blir avvist av kjæresten.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Truth Will Set You Free
programme.desc: Mike klarer ikke å vente lenger med å avsløre 'sannheten' for Snookis kjæreste. Pauly, Vinny og Deena synes det er vanskelig å være de single i huset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: One Meatball Stands Alone
